upstream.base_commit_note: first (only) parent of the squash-merge 15ed8e5256317e9ef8e81c8e074c8816d0e7fa1e of PR #10336
upstream.archive_method: git archive --format=tar.gz of the base commit from the blobless clone research/cache/v2/pydata__xarray; no .git, no solution, no hidden tests (xarray/backends/chunks.py and xarray/tests/test_backends_chunks.py absent)

feature.composition_note: PR #10516 (merged 2025-09-08, closes #10501) fixes #10336: Dataset.to_zarr never forwarded align_chunks, build_grid_chunks mis-handled chunk_size >= size, and the kwarg was renamed nd_var_chunks -> nd_v_chunks. Its non-test changes were ported onto the #10336 base (xarray/backends/chunks.py taken verbatim from 40c27d19d169ccf1c469255c6c6da327f5822d01; intervening diffs were ruff-only); its tests are included in the hidden set. Without it the single-writer-per-chunk oracle fails on Datasets.

hidden_tests.upstream_modification: test_dataarray_to_zarr_align_chunks_true upstream calls skip_if_zarr_format_3(tmp_store), which skips unconditionally under zarr-python 3; replaced with the class's ZipStore-only skip so the test actually runs (tmp_path and Dict variants); the ZipStore variant is deselected.

oracle.reference: zarr-python 3.0.8 reads every written store directly (values, chunks, shape, dtype, dimension metadata); NumPy eager writes are the value oracle; an instrumented zarr MemoryStore counts set() per chunk key to prove each Zarr chunk is written by exactly one Dask task; spec-derived property checks on the alignment helpers (boundary alignment, size bound, idempotence).

crosscheck.note: no case or expected value shared with the PR tests; reference reader is zarr-python, not xarray

upstream_regression.note: pre-existing upstream zarr tests restored from pristine; 120 node ids that skip or xfail under the pinned wheels are deselected

oracle.zarrs_rust_reader: not included: building zarrs_tools needs a Rust toolchain and ~10 min of network fetches; zarr-python is the spec reference implementation and suffices for values/chunks/metadata
oracle.reward_rule: all four groups pass with exact counts, zero skips/xfails, anti-cheat clean, import probe resolves to the submitted package

contamination.notes: Both PRs are public since 2025 and described in the xarray 2025.06.0 and 2025.09 release notes; nothing in pydata/xarray merged in 2026 is feature-scale on the zarr/encoding/indexing theme (see STATUS.md). The hidden set adds 51 authored differential cases and un-skips an upstream test that never ran under zarr-python 3, so a memorised gold still has to satisfy checks that were never public.

horizon.proxy: 5 source files, +372/-89 non-test lines, 3 subsystems (new xarray.backends.chunks algorithm module; zarr backend write path incl. region/append offsets and safe_chunks relocation; Dataset/DataArray/backends.api signature plumbing with docstrings)
horizon.why_hard: the alignment policy must reproduce exact chunk tuples for offset regions while respecting a size bound and idempotence; the option must reach the store through the Dataset path; region offsets and append offsets must be folded into the grid; safe_chunks validation must be relocated without changing its rules; 950 upstream zarr tests must keep passing

evidence: https://github.com/pydata/xarray/issues/10501 (silent data loss on append with dask, 2025-07)
https://github.com/pydata/xarray/pull/10336 (whats-new 2025.06.0: 'Data corruption issues arising from misaligned Dask and Zarr chunks can now be prevented using the new align_chunks parameter')
https://github.com/pydata/xarray/pull/10516 (whats-new bug fix: align_chunks not passed through Dataset.to_zarr)
